title: Tropical Sunset Beach Wallpaper (Flux)
description: Tropical beach sunset perfect for travel agency content, vacation rental marketing, and desktop wallpapers.

prompt.main: tropical sunset beach in bali, golden hour light over calm ocean, silhouetted palm trees on white sand, distant fishing boats, soft pink and orange sky reflected in wet sand, peaceful travel photography, nikon z9 24-70mm f/2.8

explained.why: Low guidance for natural sunset softness. Higher makes it overcooked.

tutorial.intro: Tropical sunset = named location + "golden hour" + "silhouetted palm" + "reflected in wet sand" + named lens.
steps: Location: tropical sunset beach in bali 鈥?specific location.
Light: golden hour light over calm ocean 鈥?golden hour + calm water.
Subject: silhouetted palm trees on white sand 鈥?silhouette + palm = tropical.
Details: distant fishing boats, soft pink and orange sky reflected in wet sand 鈥?small details + reflection.
Camera: nikon z9 24-70mm f/2.8 鈥?real camera + lens.
tutorial.tips: Wet sand + sunset = automatic reflection. "Reflected in wet sand" doubles the sky impact.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "bali sunset beach, palm trees, golden hour --ar 16:9 --v 6.1 --s 600".
crossModel.dall_e: DALL-E 3: "A Bali tropical sunset beach with silhouetted palm trees, golden hour, nikon camera".

faq.q: Why does my sunset look like every other sunset?
faq.a: You forgot "silhouetted palm trees" + "reflected in wet sand". These two = tropical magic.

faq.q: How to get the right golden hour?
faq.a: Add "golden hour" + "soft pink and orange sky". Specify colors, not just "sunset".
16:9 + named location (Bali, Maldives, etc). Specific locations sell more than generic beaches.
